producer.name: acp normalization
producer.ingestedFrom: effort value, intent observed, or retract

transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: thought_level select uses trimmed currentValue. Boolean options use String(currentValue). Other types are ignored.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: If no thought_level value is kept, the monitor batch retracts effort key observed.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: The pipeline config path calls normalizeAcpModel only and does not emit effort:updated.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: intent on the upsert is the literal observed. No closed effort enum is applied.
